newsitem.title: USA: Suspect in Detroit killings falls from window.
newsitem.headline: Suspect in Detroit killings falls from window.

text.p: A suspect in the stabbing deaths of five people either jumped or fell from a fifth floor window at Detroit Police headquarters Thursday and landed on the steps at the front of the building, police said.
The man was rushed into surgery at Detroit Medical Center's Detroit Receiving Hospital in critical condition, a hospital spokeswoman said.
Detroit police spokeswoman Allene Ray would not identify the man, who was being questioned at the time of the incident.
The five victims were found Wednesday morning in a home on Detroit's west side. Veteran police investigators described the crime scene as one of the worst they had ever discovered.

Police identified the victims as 21-year-old Yolanda Bellamy; her children, Nathan Burns Jr., 5, and Nathan Burns III, 3; and her nephew and niece, Delvontay Bellamy, 5, and three-year-old Shafontah Bellamy.
